anchors.description: Over-the-range microwave front-face vertical extent on its right side: top-front-right corner down to the bottom-front-right corner (microwave body height).
anchors.visible_evidence: Right front corner column of the built-in over-the-range microwave is fully visible: top-front edge meets the right vertical edge (candidate point at that junction), and the bottom-front edge reaches the lower-right corner; grille slats, door glass, brand label and white bottom strip all lie between them.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Brand/model unreadable; over-the-range bodies span about 16.4-17.2 in (0.417-0.437 m) and a 24-in compact unit would be shorter. If the diagonal above is the cabinet edge with a gap, the span overlaps a little extra space.

anchors.description: Over-the-range microwave front width along the bottom front edge, from the lower-left front corner to the lower-right front corner.
anchors.visible_evidence: The microwave is mounted directly above a standard 30-in gas range and its front face (door glass plus dark control-panel area and right bezel) spans the full frame from the lower-left front corner to the lower-right front corner at the image border.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Model unreadable; nominal 30-in (0.762 m) OTR width is the US standard, but the rightmost 1-2 percent may be clipped by the frame and the two candidate points sit a few pixels inside the true corners, so the actual point-to-point chord is slightly under nominal width. A compact 24-in unit would not fit this range.
